title: Race-specific climbs 3x10min (Presolana)
terrain: Presolana, climb of 10min+ at 8-12% with runnable descent, ~600m D+

steps.target: Z3-Z4, 163-170bpm, climb at race effort, hike over 15%
Z2-Z3, 140-160bpm, descent at race effort, 172+ spm

coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 20m easy, 3x(10min climb at 163-170bpm + 10min descent at race effort, 172+ spm), 10m easy. ~1h30, ~600m D+. Morning, before the evening flight.
GYM: none.
FUEL: Tailwind 500ml + 1 gel at 45min (race kit check).
GARMIN: ~130.
STOP RULE: HRV under 55, RHR 52+ or quads sore from Sat = 2 climbs, descents easy. No extra reps if it feels good.
WHY: last race-pace stimulus on real terrain, replaces the uphill lost on Tue 27 (flat outdoor). D-5: this is the ceiling.
